claim: 左 DLPFC high-frequency rTMS 對 depression 達 IFCN Level A efficacy；這不代表每位患者都有 clinically meaningful benefit
limitations: guideline evidence window through 2018; protocol/device specific

claim: iTBS 對 10-Hz rTMS 在 TRD 的症狀改善達 non-inferiority，且每次療程約 3 分鐘對 37.5 分鐘
limitations: open-label treatment; assessors masked; noninferiority is not superiority to sham

claim: Accelerated individualized iTBS/SNT sham-controlled RCT納入29名接受治療者（active 14、sham 15），4-week MADRS reduction 52.5% vs 11.1%；早期約90% remission來自open-label work，不能混算或泛化
limitations: small single-center RCT; replication and durability matter

claim: FDA 2018 OCD authorization 涉及 BrainsWay deep TMS system與特定 protocol，不等於所有 rTMS 均獲核准
limitations: US device-specific regulatory scope

claim: 右 DLPFC high-frequency rTMS 對 PTSD 在 2020 IFCN guideline 為 Level B；2024 Cochrane review 顯示 active rTMS 對短期 PTSD severity 可能 little-to-no difference，且 protocol 與 participant 異質
limitations: guideline evidence window differs from contemporary pooled evidence; remission and durability insufficient

claim: Lateral prefrontal/insular deep rTMS結合cue provocation的multicenter RCT中，ITT efficacy set n=234，Week-18 continuous quit rate 19.4% active vs 8.7% sham（p=0.017）；僅限該tobacco/device/protocol
limitations: cannot extrapolate to other substances, coils, targets, or protocols without cue provocation

claim: Precuneus rTMS 24-week phase-2 RCT 顯示 AD functional/cognitive decline signal，但 n=50 不足以建立 routine treatment
limitations: single-center phase 2; replication required

claim: AD/MCI component network meta-analysis納入27個double-blind RCTs（n=1070）；short-term general cognition中HF-rTMS SMD 1.08（95% CI 0.35–1.80）、anodal tDCS SMD 0.56（0.03–1.09），但MCI subgroup未呈相同positive effect，不能視為確立療法
limitations: protocol/outcome heterogeneity; estimates do not include tACS and do not establish disease modification

claim: tDCS 對 MDD 在 ELECT-TDCS 未達對 escitalopram non-inferiority；可優於 placebo 不等於可取代藥物
limitations: single-center; specific montage/dose and 10-week protocol

claim: 2017 IFCN tDCS guideline 沒有任何 indication 達 Level A；部分 depression/addiction montage 達 Level B
limitations: evidence through Sep 2016

claim: Schizophrenia cognition tDCS 有較新 RCT positive signals，但跨研究仍受樣本、montage、outcome與replication限制
limitations: single trial does not establish guideline-level efficacy

claim: tDCS 的 anodal-excitatory/cathodal-inhibitory heuristic 在非運動皮質、不同 dose 與 cortical geometry 下不可直接套用
limitations: intracranial field measurement plus polarity meta-review; behavioral direction remains state-dependent

claim: tACS 可造成 frequency/phase-sensitive online modulation；若未排除 retinal/cutaneous pathways與recording artifact，不能宣稱 direct cortical entrainment
limitations: concurrent recordings require artifact controls

claim: tACS offline alpha power增加可能反映 plasticity而非持續 entrainment
limitations: healthy adults; mechanism inferred from phase discontinuity manipulation

claim: tACS cognition meta-analyses顯示小至中等 positive signals，但 reaction time可為null且異質性高
limitations: publication bias and protocol heterogeneity

claim: Healthy-adult cognitive enhancement across rTMS/TBS/tDCS/tACS generally small、task-specific且不穩定，不能外推臨床功能改善
limitations: different tasks and stimulation protocols

claim: TMS/TBS可作 temporal-spatial causal perturbation，但 network propagation、state dependence與compensation使『區域=功能』推論過度簡化
limitations: lesion analogy limited; direct and remote network effects must be distinguished

claim: 2026 guideline在逾300,000次tES sessions中未報告tES-related serious adverse events；≤4 mA、≤60 min/day範圍內常見temporally associated AEs為tingling/burning、headache與fatigue
limitations: AE is not identical to confirmed causal side effect; higher-dose evidence and under-reporting/monitoring remain limited; safety is not efficacy

claim: TMS 最嚴重但罕見風險為 seizure；metal/electronic implants、medication與個人風險需依 current guideline逐案screen
limitations: avoid quoting one universal seizure rate across protocols

claim: NIBS evidence should be represented as modality × protocol × target/network × brain state × endpoint × timescale，而非單一 modality 排名
limitations: conceptual synthesis; not a validated prediction model
